AdminConsole._comment: Auth model: DB-managed operators (arch.ConsoleOperator) are the primary path - domain-independent, no SSMS/AD accounts. Seed the default 'admin' with migration 064 (run hash-password, paste hash). Reads (Dashboard/Analysis/Runs/Document lookup) are anonymous; edits (Configuration/Validation/Go-live) require a username+password login. DbOperatorsEnabled=true asserts >=1 enabled operator is seeded. EditPasswordSha256 (no-username shared password) and WindowsAuthEnabled (AD allowlist) are OFF but available as opt-in fallbacks.
